title: Feature Explorer (SettingsAndHelp)

scenarios.title: Feature Explorer applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Feature Explorer (BtnExploreFeatures) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Explorer overflow uses the no-chrome host capacity and collapses when the row fits
scenarios.expected: FeatureExplorerNavigationPlanner.Create reports no navigation when the full category row fits the host capacity, reports navigation past the tolerance, and collapses navigation - with a zero offset - once the row fits again even while the rendered viewport still reflects the chevron reduction.

scenarios.title: The overflow threshold is stable at the tolerance boundary
scenarios.expected: A content width exactly within the documented tolerance of the host capacity does not request navigation, while the first width beyond it does.

scenarios.title: Navigation availability follows the clamped scroll offset
scenarios.expected: The state's CanScrollLeft/CanScrollRight reflect start, middle and end offsets, and an out-of-range offset is clamped to the scrollable width.

scenarios.title: Revealing a category moves the offset only for items outside the viewport
scenarios.expected: CalculateRevealOffset returns the smallest valid offset that exposes an off-screen category item, leaves an already visible item untouched and reveals a partially visible item to its far edge.

scenarios.title: Reveal offsets are clamped and content that fits never scrolls
scenarios.expected: CalculateRevealOffset clamps into the scrollable range and returns zero when the content fits the viewport or the viewport is unusable.

scenarios.title: Sidebar and Settings feature list icons render
scenarios.expected: Every entry of the Sidebar and Settings feature lists renders its catalog icon in Light and Dark mode, including sources with a 256-unit viewBox (BtnChartOverlay, BtnAddSticker, BtnTransparency).
ownerSteps: Open the Sidebar and the Settings window in Light mode and confirm every feature row shows its icon.
Switch to Dark mode and repeat the visual check.
Confirm BtnChartOverlay, BtnAddSticker and BtnTransparency render at normal icon size instead of being clipped.
